summary: A client based in Mexico (currently traveling, spotty internet) who lost access to his Instagram page and hired Derek to recover it, plus additional appeals work. He confirmed Derek's identity on 2026-08-19, paid at least a partial amount that day and completed the payment by 2026-08-20, then handed over the account login (DiasDiamondz@gmail.com) and offered email credentials as well. There is a second page belonging to a Spanish-speaking associate that also needs recovery — he asked to move to WhatsApp/group chat so his non-English-speaking friend could join. As of 2026-08-24 he said he would be sending full payment for the appeals; follow up on collecting that payment, getting the email logins, and starting the second account's recovery.
